name: Ability Data Attachment Modifier
description: While enabled, watches a list of the entity's other abilities and, for each enabled one, adds, subtracts or sets a shared number data attachment at its own rate and timer.

fields.description: The id of the number-valued data attachment to modify, shared by every entry.

fields.type: List of Ability Entries (ability, operation*, value, rate*)
fields.description: Each entry references one of the entity's own abilities (e.g. "fsang:marvel/mutant/cosmic_herald#some_ability"), an operation* ("add" default, "subtract", or "set"), a value used by that operation, and a rate* (default 20 ticks) - the referenced ability's own enabled state is checked every tick, and the modification fires every "rate" ticks it stays enabled.

name: Telekinesis
description: While enabled, lets the user telekinetically lift the entity or block they're looking at within range, holding it in front of them at a scroll-adjustable distance up to max_distance until released or invalidated.

fields.description: How far away an entity or block can be to be picked up in the first place.
The farthest the held target can be pushed away via scrolling, with a minimum of 1 block.
Additional blocks that can never be lifted, alongside blocks with a block entity and unbreakable blocks, which are always excluded.
If set, this particle effect is continuously spawned around the held target while it's held.
If set, the held target glows this color, visible only to the user, while held.

name: Throw Blocks
description: On activation, picks up to "amount" breakable ground blocks within "radius", optionally lifts them, then launches them where you aim, dealing "damage" and dropping their item on impact.

fields.description: How many blocks to throw per activation.
Horizontal search radius (in blocks) around the user to pick candidate ground-surface blocks from.
Damage dealt to a living entity hit by a thrown block.
Launch speed of each thrown block.
Random aim spread applied to each throw, where 0 is perfectly straight.
If set, spawns this particle effect around each block continuously while lifting and in flight.
If set, each block glows this color, visible to everyone, while lifting and in flight.
How long each picked block hovers, rising 2 blocks, before being thrown, with 0 throwing immediately without lifting.

name: Reconstruction
description: On activation, matches the item in "target_slot" against "reconstructions" and consumes the first match with enough input to produce its result. With "recipe", hold to browse crafting recipes for the held item and release to swap.

fields.description: Either the ordered list of input-to-result conversions this ability can perform (each entry has "input" (an item/tag ingredient), "input_amount" (default 1), "result" (the output item stack), an optional "result_amount" override, and an optional "priority" (default 0, higher checked first)), or the literal string "recipe" to instead browse crafting-table recipes using the held item, ignoring every other ingredient in those recipes and only consuming the held item.
Which slot's item is checked and consumed; defaults to the main hand.
SINGLE applies the matched recipe once, MAXIMUM applies it as many times as the available input allows, FIXED applies it up to "fixed_amount" times. Ignored in recipe mode.
How many times to apply the recipe when conversion_mode is FIXED. Ignored in recipe mode.
FAIL cancels the whole conversion if the result can't fully fit in the inventory; DROP inserts what fits and drops the rest at the user's feet.

RESULT_ONLY uses exactly the configured result's components; COPY_SAFE also copies cosmetic components (name, lore, dyed color, custom model data) from the input; COPY_ALL copies every component the input differs from its item's defaults.

name: Show Both Arms
description: Enables the rendering of your off-hand in first-person.

name: Save Location
description: When activated, saves the entity's position, facing direction and dimension under "namespace" (overwriting any prior save there), persisting on the entity for later use by argon:teleport_to_location.

fields.description: The name the location is saved under, retrievable by any argon:teleport_to_location ability using the same namespace, on any power.

name: Auto Attack
description: While enabled, moves the player toward the nearest mob in range, auto-jumping over obstacles, then melee-attacks it with the held item once it's within attack range.

fields.description: How far from the player a mob can be to be selected as a target and chased.
How close the target needs to be before the player stops moving and attacks it instead.
The player's movement speed, in blocks per tick, while chasing a target outside attack range.

name: Damage
description: When activated, raycasts forward and deals a fixed amount of damage, as a given damage type, to the first living entity hit within range.

fields.description: How far forward the hit raycast reaches.
The amount of damage dealt to the target, plus the user's attack damage attribute if apply_user_damage is true.
The damage type the damage is dealt as.
If true, adds the user's current attack damage attribute (including equipment and effect modifiers) on top of "damage".

name: Team Chat
description: On activation, opens a client-side team chat GUI, visible only to online teammates, that stays open until closed and notifies teammates not viewing it via regular chat.

fields.description: If set, always used as the chat window's title instead of the default "<Team Name> Chat".

name: Sweeping Edge
description: While enabled, every melee hit also damages other living entities near the target, like a sweep attack without needing a sword or full charge. Skipped when vanilla would already sweep.

fields.description: Fraction of the primary hit's damage dealt to each other entity caught in the sweep.
How far, in blocks, beyond the target's own hitbox to search for other entities to sweep.
Maximum distance, in blocks, from the attacker itself that a swept entity can be.
Knockback strength applied to each swept entity, away from the attacker's facing direction. 0 disables knockback.
Whether to play the vanilla sweep sound/particle effect whenever this actually sweeps at least one entity.

name: Action On Hit
description: Performs actions to a victim when the entity with the ability damages them.

fields.description: Action(s) that are performed when an entity is attacked

Condition(s) that must be met for an entity to be affected by the ability. If no conditions are specified, then all entities will be affected. If multiple conditions are specified, then only entities that satisfy all conditions will be affected.
If false, then projectiles and other non-direct damage will also trigger the Action(s).

name: Projectile
description: Shoots a projectile entity

fields.description: ID of an entity type (must be a projectile).
Additional NBT data for the projectile entity.
Inaccurary when shooting the projectile
Velocity with which the projectile is being shot
The arm which will swing when the projectile is being shot
Usually, the current velocity of player will be added to the projectile's velocity. This setting can disable that.
A [x, y, z] spawn offset, relative to the entity's facing direction. Defaults to [0, 0, 0].

name: Blast
description: Shoots a piece of a beam into the direction the player is looking at. The blast keeps the direction it was fired in and only deals damage once it reached its target.

fields.description: The id of the beam renderer to use
The damage the blast deals to entities
The damage type used when an entity is hit. If not set, it counts as a normal player or mob attack.
The maximum distance the blast can travel
The blocks the blast travels per tick
The length of the blast in blocks
The amount of ticks the hit entity is set on fire
If the blast should cause fire on blocks. Claim protection, spawn protection and the mobGriefing gamerule (for non-players) are respected
If the blast should smelt hit blocks. Claim protection, spawn protection and the mobGriefing gamerule (for non-players) are respected
Action(s) that are performed when the blast hits an entity. They run for the entity that was hit.

Action(s) that are performed when the blast hits a block. They run for the entity that fired the blast, but commands and sounds are positioned where the blast hits, and the hit block is used as the block position.

name: Possess
description: Lets the user see through, and optionally control the movement of, a possessed living entity until a configured exit condition triggers.

fields.description: How far away a living entity can be to be possessed in the first place.
If true, the user's own body taking damage while possessing immediately ends the possession.
How many times the user can jump straight from one possessed target to another, or never if 0.
If set, possession ends once the target strays this many blocks from the user's stationary body.
If true, the user's movement input controls the target instead of being locked, gated for players by the possessMovementOverrideCanAffectPlayers config option.

name: Player Skin Change
description: An ability that changes the player's skin to the one of a Minecraft player one.

fields.description: The username of the player you want to turn into.
Priority for the skin (in case multiple skin changes are applied, the one with the highest priority will be used)

name: Reveal
description: While enabled, shows a client-side nametag above every entity within radius, visible only to the ability holder and through walls unless hidden by specific block types via blocked_by.

fields.description: The radius, in blocks, within which entities are revealed.
Which entities to reveal, either living entities only (excluding armor stands) or all entities, including non-living ones which only show a name.
Whether to show the entity's name.
Whether to show the entity's current / max health.
Whether to show the entity's Palladium powers, by name.
If set, overrides just the name's color (not health/powers) for hostile entities.
If set, overrides just the name's color (not health/powers) for non-hostile entities.
If set, hides a revealed entity's tag when one of these block types blocks the line of sight to the caster's eyes.

name: Push Field
description: While enabled, continuously applies a vertical or horizontal velocity impulse to every living entity touching the entity's (optionally inflated) hitbox, pushing or pulling based on the amount's sign.

fields.description: How much to inflate the entity's hitbox when checking for entities to affect.
Whether to push vertically (up/down) or horizontally (away from/toward the user).
The velocity applied each tick, whose sign controls direction: up/down for vertical, away/toward the user for horizontal.
Whether projectiles touching the hitbox should also be pushed, in addition to living entities.

name: Fluid Walking
description: Allows the entity to walk on a specific fluid.

fields.description: The fluid tag(s) the entity can walk on.

name: Wall Climbing
description: Allows the player to climb up walls.

name: Shader Effect
description: Applies a shader effect to the player.

fields.description: The ID of the shader that shall be applied.

name: Hearing
description: Client-side only. Labels each sound you hear with its subtitle and pins it in the world until it fades. Sounds beyond their normal range are forwarded up to "range" blocks as silent markers.

fields.description: The farthest a sound can be from the holder, in blocks, and still be shown, including sounds the server forwards from beyond their normal broadcast distance. Capped at 512 for forwarded sounds.
How long a sound's marker lasts before it is gone. It stays fully visible for the first 60% and fades over the rest.
The most markers shown at once; the oldest are dropped first.
Whether sounds that have no subtitle in the game's sound definitions are shown too, labeled with the sound's own id.
Whether markers are visible through blocks.
Whether sounds made at the holder's own position (their footsteps, their hurt sound) are skipped.
Size multiplier for the marker text.
The text color, white by default.

Sound categories that are never shown: any of master, music, record, weather, block, hostile, neutral, player, ambient, voice, ui. Sounds that are not placed in the world (interface sounds) are always skipped.

Whether footsteps taken on a soft surface cannot be heard: a step sound is skipped when the block the walker stands in or on is one of the "muffling_blocks". The server applies the same rule to sounds it forwards from far away.

The blocks that muffle footsteps when "muffle_footsteps" is on, given as explicit block IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both. Left unset, it is vanilla's "#minecraft:dampens_vibrations" tag, which is wool and carpets.

name: Takeoff
description: Hold the Takeoff key (Controls > Argon, unbound by default) to charge and release to be launched, harder the longer it was held. One push only, not flight; pair it with argon:took_off to continue into flight.

fields.description: Whether charging can only begin on the ground (checked on the server).
Whether a charge that began on the ground is dropped once the player has left it (walking off a ledge, jumping).
Whether the player can walk while charging. If false, their walking speed is held at zero until they release or cancel.
How long the key has to be held before releasing launches. Releasing sooner just cancels, with no launch and no cooldown.
How long a full charge takes. Holding longer does not add strength; the player stays fully charged until they release.
How long after a successful launch before another can be charged. 0 for none. Cancelled charges do not start it.
The upward speed, in blocks per tick, of the weakest launch (about 0.42 is a normal jump). 0.6 gets roughly 2.7 blocks.
The upward speed of a full charge, which is never exceeded. 1.7 gets roughly 15 blocks before gravity wins.
Starts the player's available palladium:flight at the top of the climb so they stay in the air. Needs an unlocked flight ability; does nothing without one.

Which way the push goes: "vertical" (straight up), "look_direction" (where the player looks on release, same strength at any angle) or "hybrid" (up, bent toward the look direction by "directional_influence").
look_direction only: the lowest launch angle, in degrees above the horizon (negative is below it). 0 never launches downward; -90 means no limit.

hybrid only: 0 to 1, how much the look direction bends the launch away from straight up. 0 is straight up, 1 the most the mode allows. It is strongest looking level and fades to nothing looking straight up or down, and it never changes how hard the launch is, only where it points.
hybrid only: 0 to 1, the least the launch's vertical share of its own length may be, whatever the influence and the camera: 0.5 keeps at least half of the push pointing up, 1 makes it straight up.

Whether the burst of debris when the launch happens is thrown away from the launch direction (backward for a forward launch) instead of spreading out around the player. Looks the same as before for a straight-up launch.
Whether the push replaces the player's whole velocity. By default sideways speed is kept (never raised above what they had or max_launch_strength), so launches can't be chained for unlimited speed.
How strength follows the charge: "linear", "ease_in" (weak early, much stronger near full), "ease_out" (strong early, small gains near full) or "ease_in_out".

fields.type: { enabled, radius, count, interval, rise_speed, lifetime, scale, scales_with_charge }
fields.description: Debris from the ground blocks around the player while charging. Keys: enabled (true), radius (2.5), count (4), interval (2 ticks), rise_speed (0.12), lifetime (24 ticks), scale (1), scales_with_charge (none, count, speed or both). Client-only.
Debris thrown up on launch, scaled by its strength. Keys: burst (true), count (40), radius (3), strength (0.4 blocks per tick).

name: Lock Slots
description: While enabled, prevents items in the listed slots from being removed, swapped, or otherwise changed.

fields.description: The slots to lock in place.

name: Tentacle Retrieval
description: While enabled, sends idle appendages to fetch dropped items within "search_range", one per item up to "maximum_active_appendages", pulling them at "pull_speed" into your inventory once within "pickup_range".

fields.description: How far, in blocks, this ability looks for dropped items to fetch.
How many appendages this ability claims and uses at once, each fetching a separate item.
How close a fetched item must get to the wearer before it's added to their inventory.
Fraction of the remaining distance a fetched item closes toward the wearer each tick (0-1); higher pulls it in faster.

name: Flight Speed Adjuster
description: A saved flight speed dial from "min_value" to "max_value" (starting at "default_value"), changed by a dependent mod's adjust(entity, steps). Read it with argon:flight_speed or argon:flight_speed_percent.

fields.description: current_value is divided by this to get the speed added to the flight type's base speed.
The lowest the dial can be adjusted to.
The highest the dial can be adjusted to.
The dial's starting value when this ability is first granted.

name: palladium.ability.argon.energy_bar_color
description: While enabled, draws one of the power's energy bars in a different color, easing in and out. Put the conditions in the ability's state. Only changes the wearer's own screen.

fields.description: The energy bar to recolor, as "power#bar_name".
The color to draw the bar in while this ability is enabled.
When several of these are enabled for one bar, the highest priority is used.
How long the bar takes to slide to this color (and, once this stops applying, back).

name: Area Action
description: An ability that can perform one or many action objects on living entities within a certain range.

fields.description: Action(s) that are performed during the first tick of the ability
Action(s) that are performed during each tick of the ability
Action(s) that are performed during the last tick of the ability

Condition(s) that must be met for an entity to be affected by the ability. If no conditions are specified, then all entities will be affected. If multiple conditions are specified, then only entities that satisfy all conditions will be affected.
The area around the player that entities are looked for.
Decides if the player executing should also be effected.

name: Size
description: Changes the size of the entity while the ability is enabled, smoothly reverting when disabled.

fields.description: The target size multiplier (multiplicative with other active size modifiers). Clamped to the size change type's min/max size.
The size change type defining the transition duration and easing.

name: Highlight
description: Client-side only, tints the entity's model (and optionally matching blocks in range) with a color, visible through walls to the ability holder alone.

fields.description: Whether this ability highlights the entity itself or lets you see other entities (self, others). Seeing others also needs "highlight_entities".
The highlight color, defaulting to the team color for entities or white for blocks when unset.
How strong the tint is, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (fully opaque).
The distance at which entities (in "others" mode) and enabled matching blocks are highlighted.
If true, in "others" mode, highlights the entities within "distance", through walls. Off by default, so "others" only shows blocks unless this is set. Has no effect in "self" mode.

The entity types to highlight when "highlight_entities" is true, given as explicit entity type IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both. Left unset, every living entity in range is highlighted.
If true, also highlights every block matching "blocks" within "distance", through walls.
The blocks to highlight when "highlight_blocks" is true, given as explicit block IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both.
Block types that still block line of sight for this effect, hiding anything behind them while everything else stays visible through walls.

name: Prevent Sprinting
description: Prevents the player from sprinting.

name: Hide Body Part
description: Hides the specified body parts of the entity.

fields.description: The body parts to hide.
Determines if the first person arm should disappear as well (if it's disabled).

name: Fluid Transfer
description: While enabled, periodically moves "value" of the specified fluid every "rate" ticks from the fluid item in "from_slot" into the fluid item in "to_slot", clamped by available source fluid and destination room.

fields.description: Which slot to take the fluid-storing item to draw from.
Which slot to take the fluid-storing item to fill.
The fluid that must be stored on both the "from_slot" and "to_slot" items for the transfer to happen.
The amount to move per transfer, evaluated fresh every time the ability transfers fluid.
How long to wait between transfers.

name: Totem Animation
description: On activation, plays the Totem of Undying animation and sound for the given item, client-side and only for the holder, without the particle burst others would see.

fields.description: The item to display in the animation.

name: Item Storage
description: While enabled, shows a scrollable strip of item slots near the hotbar that right-click swaps with the mainhand, storing items on the entity by default or on a specified equipment/Curios slot instead.

fields.description: The total number of storable slots.
List of item ids allowed to be stored, or any item if left empty.
If set, items are stored on the item in this equipment or Curios slot instead of on the entity.
Pixel offset applied to the slot strip's on-screen position relative to its default placement above the hotbar.

name: Multi Jump
description: While enabled, lets the entity jump again in mid-air up to a set number of times before it needs to touch the ground again to refill its extra jumps. Fall damage is only taken for the distance fallen below the position of the last extra jump.

fields.description: How many extra mid-air jumps the entity can perform before landing again.
The vertical velocity applied per extra jump. Defaults to the same strength as a normal jump.
The horizontal velocity added in the direction the entity is facing per extra jump.
Sound played whenever an extra jump is performed.

name: Prevent Gliding
description: Prevents & stops the player from gliding with an elytra.

name: Shrink Body Overlay
description: An ability that shrinks the body overlay of the entity.

name: Damage Immunity
description: Makes the entity immune against certain damage types.

fields.description: The damage types the entity is immune against.

name: Step Down
description: Allows for stepping down blocks quickly.

fields.description: Speed at which you fall off the block.
Fall distance it will enable at.
If false, checks for if the ability SHOULD be enabled such as the entity being in spectator, fall flying, swimming, or on the ground will be disabled.
If true, it will work for living vehicles.
If true, it will work in fluids.
The fluid the entity can walk down when in.

name: Explosion
description: On activation, creates an explosion centered on the user, dealing damage and knockback to nearby entities.

fields.description: The explosion's power and radius (for reference, TNT is 4).
Whether the explosion breaks blocks in range like real TNT, or only affects entities and leaves terrain untouched when false.
Whether the user takes damage and knockback from their own explosion, or is excluded from it while others still take full damage.

name: Tentacle Arms
description: While enabled, grows the appendages defined by "profile", opening over "open_time" ticks and closing over "close_time" (instant at 0). Idle animation only; other appendage abilities give them actions.

fields.description: The id of the appendage_profile (data/<namespace>/argon/appendage_profiles/) defining count, segments, attachment points, and idle behavior.

Ticks to open from fully closed to fully open after enabling (the mechanical reference animation is about 10 ticks). 0 (default) skips the animation - appendages are simply present as soon as enabled.
Ticks to close from fully open back to nothing after disabling. 0 (default) skips the animation - appendages simply disappear as soon as disabled.

name: Lightning
description: On activation, strikes the block or entity the user is looking at with a lightning-like beam that damages nearby living entities, defaulting to maximum range if the raycast hits nothing.

fields.description: The maximum distance, in blocks, the raycast can reach when finding a block or entity to strike.
The id of the beam renderer used to draw the strike, e.g. one under data/<namespace>/palladium/beams/.
The damage dealt to living entities near the impact point, or none by default.
How far from the impact point, in blocks, entities can still take damage.
How many ticks the beam visual stays on screen.

The damage type the damage is dealt as, a damage type ID such as "minecraft:magic" or one added by a pack. Left unset, the damage is exactly what it always was: a player attack when a player uses this and a mob attack otherwise. If the damage type does not exist, that default is used.

name: Push
description: On activation, applies a one-time vertical or horizontal velocity impulse to every living entity in range, pushing or pulling based on the amount's sign.

fields.description: How far from the entity other living entities can be to be affected.
Whether to push vertically (up/down) or horizontally (away from/toward the user).
The velocity applied, whose sign controls direction: up/down for vertical, away/toward the user for horizontal.

name: Dual Wielding
description: Lets you attack with the item in your off hand by right-clicking. The off hand has its own attack cooldown, and the attack only happens if right-clicking didn't already do something else, like placing a block or eating. While active, your empty off hand is also shown in first person.

name: Path Vision
description: Client-side only. Shows where nearby entities and projectiles are heading: a mob's AI route, a short prediction for other movers, a projectile's predicted flight. Drawn as a trail; changes nothing.

fields.description: How far from the holder, in blocks, entities and projectiles are looked for. Only loaded entities are ever considered.
The most targets shown at once. Which ones are kept when there are more is decided by target_priority.

Which targets are kept when more than max_targets are in range and which come first: "closest" orders by distance, "hostile_first" puts hostile mobs before everything else, "projectiles_first" puts projectiles first. Within a group the closest come first.
How often paths are recalculated. Between updates the trail follows the target smoothly, and a new navigation path from the server updates it immediately.
The longest stretch of path shown, measured along the path itself from the target.

What is shown, mixing categories ("players", "hostile", "passive", "neutral", "projectiles", "mobs", "all") with entity type ids and "#tags". Listed types and tags are tracked whatever their category. An unknown entry stops the power from loading.
Anything that matches here is never shown, even when it matches track. Takes the same entries as track.
Whether paths are shown for mobs and players.

Whether an entity with no active navigation path gets a physics prediction from its recent velocity. A prediction is an estimate, not a destination: it assumes the entity keeps going the way it is going.
How far ahead entity movement is predicted. Longer predictions get less reliable.
Whether the flight of projectiles is shown.
How far ahead a projectile's flight is simulated. The path also stops at the first expected collision.
Whether a particle marks where a projectile is expected to hit. Nothing is shown when no impact is predicted.
Whether the time left before the predicted impact is written above the impact point, such as 0.8s.
The particle that marks the predicted impact, as a particle type ID or a particle object.

Shows the path a shot would take while its shooter aims (a drawn bow, a ready trident or a loaded crossbow) instead of following fired projectiles. It ends at the first block or tracked entity hit and uses projectile_trail. Fireworks aren't predicted.
preview_aimed_shots only: the aim line's color when the draw has just started, shifting to the projectile trail's color as the shot becomes ready. Set it to the trail's color to turn the shift off.
The Palladium trail (palladium/trails/<path>.json) that draws entity paths. Its renderer, lifetime, offset and spacing set the look.
The Palladium trail that draws paths of projectiles, set up the same way as entity_trail, so projectiles can look different from entities. Defaults to "argon:path_vision_projectile".
Paths of targets farther than this from the camera are not drawn.
How much navigation corners are rounded. A rounded stretch that would pass through a block is left sharp instead.
Whether the trail can be seen through blocks. Applies to trails drawn with Palladium's laser render types, which includes the gradient and lightning trails.

name: Movement Speed Adjuster
description: While enabled and not flying, adds "current_value / division_amount" to movement speed. The dial runs from "min_value" to "max_value" (starting at "default_value"), changed by a dependent mod's adjust(entity, steps).

fields.description: current_value is divided by this to get the actual attribute bonus.
The lowest the dial can be adjusted to.
The highest the dial can be adjusted to.
The dial's starting value when this ability is first granted.

name: Item Database (Store)
description: On activation, consumes one copy of the item in the user's main hand and stores it in their account-wide item database, unless blacklisted by config.

name: Breath
description: Changes how much air the entity can hold and how fast it refills when it can breathe. A bigger air supply also makes it last longer underwater, since air is still used up at the normal speed. Multiple active Breath abilities multiply with each other.

fields.description: The maximum air as a percentage of the default 300 ticks (15 seconds). 200 doubles it.
How fast air refills as a percentage of the normal speed. 200 refills it twice as fast.

name: palladium.ability.argon.held_target
description: Deals damage, applies effects and knocks back the living entity the user is holding with argon:carry, or let go of within the last few ticks, wherever the user looks. Each entry runs on the ability's first tick, on every tick it stays enabled, or on its last tick. Nothing happens when nothing is held.

fields.type: List of { timing*, interval, damage, armor_penetration, damage_type, effects, knockback_distance, lift }
fields.description: What to do to the held target. timing is "first_tick", "tick" or "last_tick"; interval is how often a "tick" entry runs; damage is a Value; armor_penetration is the fraction from 0 to 1 of the target's armor ignored by the damage; damage_type is a damage type ID (unset, a player attack); effects is a list of { effect*, duration, amplifier, particles }; knockback_distance (Value, blocks, away from the user) and lift (Value, upward speed) are weakened by knockback resistance.
How many ticks after the target was let go it still counts as held, so an entry can run on the tick the carry ends.

name: Dodge
description: On activation, launches the entity horizontally toward its current WASD movement input, or straight backward relative to its facing direction if no movement key is held.

fields.description: The multiplier applied to the dodge direction when this ability activates.
How many ticks the dodge pose is held after activating, for animation purposes.
The multiplier used instead of velocity_modifier while the entity is flying. Unset, it is the same as velocity_modifier.
While flying, whether the dodge follows where the entity looks, including up and down, so it can be used to maneuver in the air. Otherwise it stays horizontal.

name: Light Source
description: While enabled, a real light-emitting block follows the entity (placed only in air or water, removed on disable) with colored particles, since block light has no color.

fields.description: How bright the emitted light is, from 0 (none) to 15 (maximum, matching a torch or brighter).

One or more particle effects (a bare object or a list) spawned around the entity every tick, each with its own "color" (defaults to a warm torch-like tone when unset), "count" (particles per tick, default 3), "offset" ([x, y, z] added to the entity's position, default [0, 0.5, 0]), and "spread" ([x, y, z] random scatter radius per axis, default [0.2, 0.2, 0.2]). Configuring several entries lets you layer differently colored/positioned effects at once; an empty list disables particles entirely, leaving only the real light.

name: Dragon Rays
description: While enabled, renders the radiating light rays the ender dragon flashes as it dies, as geometry anchored to the entity, in a configurable hex color instead of vanilla's magenta.

fields.description: The color of the rays, as a hex string (e.g. "#6dffff"). Defaults to vanilla's magenta.

name: Block Scan
description: While enabled, shows a panel beside the crosshair for the block you look at: whether it's active or powered, its energy, fluids and items, connections, damage and readable text. Only what the game exposes is shown.

fields.description: How far away, in blocks, a block can be read from.
Limit the scan to these blocks, given as explicit block IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both. Left unset, any block that has something to read is scanned.
Show whether the block is active (lit / enabled / powered) and the redstone signal it receives.
Show stored energy and capacity.
Show the fluids stored in the block's tanks.
Show how full the block's inventory is and the main items in it.
Show which neighbouring blocks it is connected to (they have energy, fluid or item storage that faces it).
Show damage the block's state reports (chipped / damaged anvils, cracked blocks).
Show readable information the block carries (a sign's text, a command block's command).

name: Biome Swap
description: While enabled, replaces terrain within "radius" of where it was activated with freshly generated terrain of "biome" (optionally in a black-concrete shell), and restores every changed block on disable.

fields.description: How far from the entity's position (1-64) the swap reaches.

The biome(s) to generate terrain from (any registered biome, vanilla or modded), given as a single ID, a list of IDs, or a list mixing bare IDs with objects that also grant a status effect to entities standing in the area - see the second example.
How many blocks below the entity's feet are included when sphere is false.
How many blocks above the entity's feet are included when sphere is false.
If true, the area becomes a full sphere enclosed by a solid black concrete shell instead of a radius-limited column.
If true, none of the newly added blocks can be broken while the ability is enabled.
If true, the area grows in and shrinks back out over a couple of seconds instead of appearing and disappearing instantly.

name: Energy Modifier
description: While enabled, periodically modifies the stored energy on the item in the given slot every "rate" ticks, never below 0 and with no effect on infinite/creative-energy items.

fields.description: Which slot to modify the energy-storing item in.
Whether "value" is added to the item's energy, subtracted from it, or set as its new energy outright.
The amount used by "operation", evaluated fresh every time the ability modifies the item.
How long to wait between modifications.

name: Entity Glow
description: Makes the entity itself glow, or lets you see other entities with their glow effect.

fields.description: Determines if this ability makes the entity itself glow ("self"), or lets you see other entities with their glow effect ("others").
Determines the color of the glow effect. If left empty, it will use the default team color.
The distance at which the glow effect is visible. If 0, it will behave normally.
A condition, evaluated on the client, that must be met for the glow to appear.

name: Invisibility
description: Makes the player invisible. Also makes mobs not see the player anymore. Adds a "fade" style for the transition.

fields.description: Opacity for other players/observers once fully invisible (0 = fully invisible).
Opacity for the local player's own view once fully invisible.
Multiplier fed into mob-sight/visibility checks once fully invisible.

How the invisibility transition is visualized. "default" matches Palladium's own fade exactly. "energy" spreads an irregular, glowing energy boundary across the model's surface as it fades in/out instead of a uniform opacity change.
Only used when "fade" is "energy": the color of the glowing transition boundary (the hottest point of the boundary brightens toward white regardless of this setting).

Only used when "fade" is "energy": texture-path prefixes (e.g. "mypack:textures/entity/suits/") of OTHER render layers that should also dissolve/tint along with the wearer's own skin. Textures drawn by the wearer's currently equipped armor/suit items are already auto-detected and don't need to be listed here - this is only a fallback for a texture that isn't reachable that way.

name: Push
description: When activated, applies a one-time velocity impulse to every living entity within range - either vertically (positive amount pushes up, negative pulls down) or horizontally, away from or toward the user's location (positive pushes away, negative pulls toward).

fields.description: How far from the entity other living entities can be to be affected.
Whether to push vertically (up/down) or horizontally (away from/toward the user).
The velocity applied. For vertical: positive is up, negative is down. For horizontal: positive pushes targets away from the user, negative pulls them toward the user.

name: Guard
description: While enabled, blocks incoming damage until a threshold is reached, at which point the guard breaks: damage is dealt to the entity and a break effect plays.

fields.description: The cumulative damage the entity can absorb while guarding before the guard breaks.
The damage dealt to the entity when the guard breaks.
How long the guard stays broken after breaking. Using the palladium:guard_broken condition inside a not condition on this ability to enable this lockout.
How much absorbed damage recovers per second while not guarding. If not set, all absorbed damage is reset as soon as the entity stops guarding.

The width, in degrees, of the arc in front of the entity's look direction that can block damage. 360 blocks from all directions, including damage without a source position (e.g. magic). Defaults to 180 (front hemisphere).
Damage types that go through the guard. Defaults to the #minecraft:bypasses_shield tag, which also covers fall, fire and void damage.
If true, the entity cannot attack entities or interact with items/blocks/entities while this ability is enabled. Only applies to players. Defaults to true.

How strongly the entity that directly hit the guarding entity is knocked away whenever a hit is blocked. Projectile shooters are not affected. 0 disables this. Defaults to 0.5 (roughly 1 block of push).
Sound played whenever a hit is blocked.
Sound played when the guard breaks.

name: Armor Slots (Retrieve)
description: Re-equips items previously stored under an ID via the store_equipment ability into their original slots, then forgets that ID.

fields.description: The ID to restore, matching the one used by the store_equipment ability that stored them.

name: Anchored Beam
description: While enabled, draws the beam_renderer anchored to a body part and extended by "length" blocks. Purely visual: no aiming or damage. With an animation_timer, the beam grows and shrinks over it.

fields.description: The id of the beam renderer whose segments to render in place.
How far, in blocks, each segment extends beyond its configured body_part/offset anchor in that same direction.

Euler rotation in degrees (applied X then Y then Z) that tilts which way each segment extends, relative to its own body part's local space - independent of the offset's own direction. E.g. [90, 0, 0] to swing a segment that otherwise hangs straight down (the default with no offset) so it points forward instead, like an upright held tool.

name: Rotate
description: While enabled, turns the entity around the vertical axis by "degrees_per_tick" every tick. For players the camera turns with it.

fields.description: How many degrees of yaw to add each tick while enabled. Negative values spin the other direction.

name: Particles
description: Spawns particles around the entity.

fields.description: List of emitter IDs where the particles spawn at.
ID of the particle you want to spawn.
Additional options for the particle (like color of a dust particle).

name: Combo Attack
description: Tracks consecutive melee attacks and deals bonus damage on the final hit of the combo. Missing a swing or hitting a block resets the combo.

fields.description: The number of consecutive attacks needed to trigger the final, bonus-damage attack.
Flat damage added to the final attack of the combo.
The amount of time, in ticks, the entity can go without attacking before the combo counter resets.
Action(s) run when the final attack of the combo lands.

name: Potion Hit
description: While enabled, applies a list of status effects to whatever living entity this one lands a damaging hit on.

fields.description: Each entry configures its own effect, duration, amplifier*, max_amplifier* (ceiling for stackable_amplifier, default 255) and particles* (default true).
If true, re-hitting a target that already has the effect adds the configured duration on top of its remaining time, instead of just reapplying the configured duration.
If true, re-hitting a target that already has the effect raises its amplifier by one level (capped at that entry's max_amplifier), instead of leaving it at the configured amplifier.
Optional condition, tested against the target, that must pass for stackable_amplifier to raise the amplifier on a re-hit.

name: Earthquake
description: On activation, launches nearby ground blocks up and outward as falling-block entities in a staggered ripple radiating from the user, never affecting the block directly beneath them.

fields.description: The horizontal radius, in blocks, around the user that can be affected.
The launch velocity (blocks/tick) applied to each affected block, both upward and outward away from the user.
How many ticks of delay to add per block of distance from the user, where higher values stagger the ripple out more slowly.
How many blocks above and below the user's feet to search, per column, for the first block to launch.
If true, zeroes the user's movement_speed and jump_strength attributes for as long as the ripple is still playing out.

name: EXP Gain
description: While enabled, periodically grants EXP for this power, typically as a hidden, always-on background ability.

fields.description: How many ticks between each EXP grant (20 ticks per second, so 1200 = one minute).
How much EXP to grant each interval.

name: Open GUI
description: Opens the chosen standalone GUI. Crafting-style menus work fully; storage ones get their own persistent inventory, and furnace-like ones run a saved simulation of vanilla smelting or brewing.

fields.description: The registered menu screen to open, as a resource ID (e.g. "minecraft:crafting").

name: Ability Bar
description: Holds the data for an ability bar UI widget whose slots the player fills from an ability pool, with optional presets and crouch variants. Has no behavior of its own.

fields.description: List of ability pool entries the player can choose from for each slot.
How many ability bar slots to offer.
How many switchable sets of slot assignments to offer, where 1 disables the preset-switching arrows.
Whether each slot also accepts a separate, crouch-only ability assignment.

If true, the slot picker hides pool abilities that aren't currently obtainable - i.e. whose unlocking condition isn't met once any ability_bar_active/ability_bar_active_crouch checks in it are ignored (since those exist to reflect this very assignment, not a real prerequisite).

name: Tool Hands
description: Allows the player to mine a block and receive its drops as if a tool were used.

fields.description: Block tags controlling what bare hands can harvest and at what tier (e.g. "minecraft:mineable/pickaxe" plus "minecraft:needs_iron_tool"), empty by default with no effect.

Enchantments the hand counts as having, each with an "enchantment" id and a "level" value (default 1; 0 turns it off). Efficiency speeds mining; Fortune and Silk Touch shape drops, even on blocks needing no tool. Combat enchantments don't apply.
